title: Image gallery with lightbox viewer
when: The user wants a grid of thumbnails that opens each image large in an overlay with next and previous controls.
prompt: Goal: A thumbnail grid of real links that a dialog lightbox enhances with keyboard, swipe and focus return. Steps: 1. Grid of each wrapping a thumbnail with alt, width, height and loading="lazy" after the first row. 2. JS intercepts the click and opens with a large img, a figcaption, a counter 3 of 12 and Previous, Next and Close buttons. 3. Keys: ArrowLeft and ArrowRight move, Home and End jump, Escape closes natively. 4. Swipe with pointer events: a horizontal move over 50 px changes image. 5. The large image fits with max-height: 85dvh and object-fit: contain; preload the next one. 6. On close, return focus to the thumbnail that opened it. Quality bar: - The large image alt matches the thumbnail alt. - Controls are 44 px and visible on dark backdrops. - Without JS the links open the full image. Pitfalls: - Divs with background images instead of img and alt. - Loading every full size image at page load. - A viewer with no visible Close. Verify: - [ ] The dialog has a name and a Close button. - [ ] Thumbnails have alt, width and height. - [ ] Arrow keys move between images. - [ ] Focus returns to the thumbnail. Output: Gallery markup, gallery.css and lightbox.js.

examples.input: galeria de fotos da obra com ampliacao
examples.output: grid of 12 thumbnail links, dialog viewer with caption, 3 of 12 counter, arrows and swipe, focus back to thumb
